subject.title: West Basin Municipal Water District Board, Division 1

text: It's an honor to serve as your West Basin Municipal Water District Director for Division I, and I respectfully ask for your vote to continue working on behalf of our communities.

As a lifelong Carson resident, I understand that clean, safe, and affordable water is essential to our quality of life and our region's future. Since my unanimous appointment to the West Basin Municipal Water District Board of Directors in 2025, I have focused on protecting our water supply, strengthening critical infrastructure, advancing local water independence, expanding recycled water, and ensuring responsible stewardship of taxpayer dollars while planning for future generations.

For more than 25 years, I have proudly been a member of IBEW Local 11 and currently serve as its Business Development Manager. My career began as a journeyman wireman building critical water and public infrastructure projects throughout Southern California. That hands-on experience gives me a unique understanding of the investments needed to maintain a reliable water system, improve water quality, strengthen our infrastructure, and create good-paying local jobs.

I believe in transparent leadership, fiscal responsibility, environmental stewardship, and working collaboratively to keep water reliable, affordable, and sustainable for every family and business we serve.
I would be honored to earn your vote and continue serving residents of Division I.

text: As a long-time CFO CPA and resident of RPV for over 30 years, I am running for West Basin Municipal Water District Director, Division 1, to secure a safe, reliable, sustainable, and cost-effective water supply for our families. Our region faces critical challenges from climate volatility, aging infrastructure, rising costs, fires, and projected severe water shortages from Colorado River supply limits. I will bring fiscal accountability, strict transparency, and proactive leadership to the board. My professional background equips me to oversee complex water-related issues; I have served as the financial expert board member on OriginClear and as former acting CFO of Santa Clara Water Waste. My primary focus will be expanding our world-class water recycling facilities, enhancing local conservation incentives, and achieving true water independence to reduce our reliance on expensive imported water. I am committed to protecting our coastal environment while keeping rates affordable for hard-working families and small businesses across Carson, the Palos Verdes Peninsula, and Rancho Dominguez. Together, we can modernize infrastructure, implement innovative sustainability, and guarantee long-term water security. I respectfully ask for your vote to bring dedicated, common-sense leadership to the District.
